{{Quote|Should leave ya with just enough to refuel the ''Mynock'' and buy a few rounds in my cantina&mdash;if ya keep to the house brands.|Rav to Cade Skywalker|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 3">[[Legacy (2006) 3|''Legacy'' (2006) 3]]</ref>}}
The '''Golden Gorg Cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located within the ''[[Crimson Axe]]'' in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. It was owned by [[Rav]], a [[Feeorin/Legends|Feeorin]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]].
